publicApi.note: LinkedIn's official Job Posting / Talent APIs are for approved ATS and Talent Solutions partners posting jobs; there is no public job search API. Needs a partner app, so not usable (design 5.1).

auth.howToCopy: In Chrome, logged in to linkedin.com: DevTools > Application > Cookies > https://www.linkedin.com. Copy the value of 'li_at' and of 'JSESSIONID'. The 'csrf-token' request header is the JSESSIONID value without its surrounding quotes (check in DevTools > Network: any /voyager/api/ request > Request Headers > csrf-token). The jobs-guest endpoints need none of these. In the secrets file the header is keyed by its bare name, csrf-token.

clauses: Develop, support or use software, devices, scripts, robots or any other means or processes (such as crawlers, browser plugins and add-ons or any other technology) to scrape or copy the Services, including profiles and other data from the Services;
Use bots or other unauthorized automated methods to access the Services
Override any security feature or bypass or circumvent any access controls or use limits of the Services

accountRisk: High. The User Agreement (section 8.2) forbids scraping and bots. LinkedIn is widely reported to restrict accounts (temporary or permanent) when it detects automated access with a member's session, including tools that copy data at low volume (e.g. Bardeen community report of a warning for 'automated tools'; datablist.com and evaboot.com guides). Using Ba's li_at cookie from a server process puts Ba's main professional account at risk of a restriction or identity-verification hold. The logged-out jobs-guest endpoints do not touch the account but are still covered by the anti-scraping clause and are IP rate-limited (429 after roughly ten pages reported).
notes: UNVERIFIED: Chrome extension was not connected, so none of these endpoints were observed in Ba's browser and no fixtures were captured; they come from third-party code and write-ups (Snyk audit of a LinkedIn jobs skill naming /voyager/api/voyagerJobsDashJobCards and /voyager/api/jobs/jobPostings/{id}; kevin-burns/linkedin-assist; linkedapi.io guide for jobs-guest). No live calls were made (high-risk board, design decision 5). Voyager responses are JSON (Rest.li normalized 'included' arrays, Accept: application/vnd.linkedin.normalized+json+2.1); the exact decorationId and query shape must be read from Ba's Network tab after approval. Voyager detail returns the full description text (description.text). jobs-guest endpoints return HTML fragments, not JSON: search = <li> job cards (25 per page, paginate with start=0,25,50...; data-entity-urn='urn:li:jobPosting:<id>'), detail = full description HTML (div.show-more-less-html__markup). Job URL: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/<id>/. Skill limits: <= 6 page loads per scan. A re-research with the Chrome extension connected is needed to confirm paths and capture search.json / detail.json fixtures before the engineer can build the mapper.
